content.text: In Zimbabwe, where foreign payment platforms like Stripe are heavily restricted, digital creators have been forced to seek alternative infrastructure to host and sell their digital products. When platforms fail, a self-sufficient digital store built on cloud-based infrastructure becomes the only viable solution. This guide shows how to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or any other payment platform.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Unlike traditional e-commerce platforms that rely on complex payment gateways, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-works-10|deploying]] a digital store on Cloudflare Pages leverages free hosting, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments for automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-infrastructure-reality-check|Crypto Payments]] payment verification. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-5|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] ensures that digital creators can have full control over their store and products, without being dependent on foreign platforms or payment gateways that may not support their local currencies or transactions. By using Cloudflare Pages, digital creators can enjoy fast and secure hosting, while also reducing their costs and increasing their flexibility.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you will need a GitHub account, a Cloudflare account, and a NOWPayments account. You will also need to have your digital products ready to upload to your store. Additionally, you will need to have a basic understanding of how to use Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. If you are unsure about any of these requirements, it is recommended that you consult the COREMERCH documentation and support resources before proceeding with the deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to configure your NOWPayments account and connect it to your Cloudflare Workers. This will allow you to accept cryptocurrency payments from your customers and automate the delivery of your digital products. You will also need to set up your Supabase database to store order information and configure your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered to your customers' inboxes. With Stack 01, this process typically takes around 4-6 hours, following the Sovereign Blueprint.
You can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free and start selling your digital products immediately.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your store and start processing transactions. To do this, you will need to deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and configure your Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming requests. You will also need to set up your NOWPayments webhook to receive notifications when a payment is made. With Stack 02, COREMERCH can deploy the entire infrastructure in 48 hours, including end-to-end testing before handoff. This ensures that your store is fully functional and ready to process transactions from day one.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, you can start scaling your infrastructure to meet the demands of your growing customer base. This may involve upgrading your Cloudflare Pages plan, increasing the number of workers in your Cloudflare Workers, or adding more storage to your Supabase database. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can have Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff, giving you a solid foundation for scaling your store and increasing your revenue.

The most important question a reader would ask is 'Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?' The answer is yes, but it's essential to note that GitHub Pages has some limitations when it comes to hosting digital stores, and Cloudflare Pages is generally a better choice for this type of use case. With Cloudflare Pages, you can enjoy fast and secure hosting, automatic SSL encryption, and a wide range of customization options.

With Stack 02, COREMERCH can deploy the entire infrastructure in 48 hours, including end-to-end testing before handoff, giving you a solid foundation for scaling your store and increasing your revenue.

This guide is particularly relevant for digital creators in countries where foreign payment platforms like Stripe are heavily restricted, such as Zimbabwe, Ghana, Kenya, and others. If you're looking for a more advanced e-commerce solution, you may want to consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, end-to-end tested before handoff, and 30-day support. You can find more information about the Edge Commerce Stack on the COREMERCH product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: create a GitHub account and a Cloudflare account, set up your NOWPayments account and connect it to your Cloudflare Workers, configure your Supabase database to store order information, set up your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered to your customers' inboxes, deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and configure your Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming requests, set up your NOWPayments webhook to receive notifications when a payment is made, and finally, test your store and ensure that it is fully functional before going live.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages?

With Stack 01, the deployment process typically takes around 4-6 hours, following the Sovereign Blueprint. With Stack 02, COREMERCH can deploy the entire infrastructure in 48 hours, including end-to-end testing before handoff.
What is the cost of deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages?

The cost of deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages is zero, thanks to the free hosting provided by Cloudflare and the free payment processing provided by NOWPayments. Additionally, if you choose to use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you will need to pay for this service.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on Cloudflare Pages, but GitHub Pages has some limitations when it comes to hosting digital stores. With Cloudflare Pages, you can enjoy fast and secure hosting, automatic SSL encryption, and a wide range of customization options.
How do I configure my payment and delivery pipeline on Cloudflare Pages?

To configure your payment and delivery pipeline on Cloudflare Pages, you will need to set up your NOWPayments account and connect it to your Cloudflare Workers, configure your Supabase database to store order information, and set up your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered to your customers' inboxes.
How do I process payments and deliver digital products on my store?

To process payments and deliver digital products on your store, you will need to set up your NOWPayments webhook to receive notifications when a payment is made, configure your Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming requests, and set up your delivery pipeline to automate the delivery of your digital products.
You have full control over your store and products, without being dependent on foreign platforms or payment gateways that may not support your local currencies or transactions.
